title: Module 6: Collaborative & Social Learning
description: Exploring Vygotsky's Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD) and Communities of Practice in modern, networked learning environments.

learning_objectives.statement: Explain how collaborative interaction can accelerate understanding and transfer
Use the Zone of Proximal Development to design peer support and coaching structures
Apply communities-of-practice thinking to online or blended learning environments

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
